title: Definitely saved us money
text: Booked the hola Barcelona travel card for our recent trip to the city. Bought through Get your Guide and purchased the 120 hours card. This cost £37 for the 5 days usage. The card needed to be redeemed at the metro station at the airport and we were able to use the R train to get us into the city with a transfer onto the metro. We found this card to be extremely good value for money and with the metro system in Barcelona being extremely efficient we travelled all over the place in those 5 days easily saving us money against purchasing individual tickets. author: ANN_I

title: Hola Barcelona Card highly recommended
text:
We bought the Hola Barcelona Card online in advance for five days.  You received a QR code. And with this, you went to the machines (red) at the metro station and scanned it. Thereupon, two physical tickets came out as cards.  Everything went very quickly and you could immediately use all public transportation for five days. 
You could use all metros, buses, and even the regional trains (Renfe) in the Barcelona area on public transit. That means you could use the regional train with this ticket from the airport to the city center and back without transferring.

title: Hola card
text: It’s easy to redeem the voucher at BCN. I saw tourists tried to redeem at those automated kiosk and they seemed to have trouble. Be careful about the actual paper card with the magnetic strip. It is easily scratched, crumpled and tender it non-operative. Mine was not working at my last trip to the cruise terminal and not easy to get help. Tram and metro stations use the card reader only not the “tap”

title: Visiting Barcelona comfortably and easily
text: Very valid ticket for visiting Barcelona without stress. The only consideration/annoyance, if purchasing online from Italy, is that upon arriving in Barcelona, you need to go to the metro machines to print the card. Everything else is fine. The price is also great when compared to other tickets. Good for Metro, Bus, airport connections, etc.

author: Flora_F

title: Lots of flexibility at a fixed price
text:
Purchased at the info point Placa of the Espanya. Activated with first drive and off we went. In conjunction with the app "Citymapper" just great. Very often buses and trains leave and we had no negative experiences in the 4 days. Small downer is the necessity of this card from 4 years. Basically but absolutely recommended and as a means of transportation from our point of view a must in the city. 
Side note: Travel to/from the airport is included.
